title: Mock2 finish-time deviation candidate (B.3 screening finding)
description: A classified simulation-disclosure match from finish-payload / change-record screening. High and ambiguous (non-negated) candidates are BLOCKING; negated are recorded only. Lexical screening is a safety net — B.4 is the primary source-level detector.

source.description: the field the match was found in, e.g. finish.assumptions.assumed

tier.description: high = automatic blocking deviation candidate; ambiguous = blocking candidate for admin resolution; negated = remediation/negation, recorded not blocking

span.description: [start, end) character offsets of the match in the source field

resolution.description: admin resolution (appended, never rewriting the candidate)
